label: Actual necessary source with possible causal exercise from BEGINS_2 opportunity (inference)
rule: Reconstruct the external causal opportunity witness; retain actual GivesAt on the same c in v; transport rigid necessity to w using Euclidean-at-w and actual reflexivity
meaning: The stronger causal B2 is applied to a possible BEGINS_2 populated history, yielding one source c with actual memberwise GivesAt exercise in a witness history v. Externality of that same c among contingent concreta implies its de re necessity in v, and Euclidean-at-w plus actual reflexivity transport its necessary existence to w without changing c or projecting the causal exercise to w. This is a non-transcription conditional theorem retaining real causal content in a possible world, not a proof of B2's warrant.
